error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE: "[UE 0] CB-RA: Contention resolution timer has expired, RA procedure has failed..."  
Location/Context: Logged in the MAC layer during the contention-based random access (CB-RA) procedure, specifically after the RA-Msg3 transmission and contention resolution timer expiration, indicating failure of the random access procedure which prevents successful RRC connection establishment.
